title: thymus fallax var. balansae
intro: Thymus fallax var. balansae, commonly known as the Balansa thyme, is a plant species in the genus Thymus. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, making it a popular choice for herbal remedies. The therapeutic actions of Balansa thyme include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as thymol and carvacrol, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
